name: accordion
title: Accordion
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: Headings that each open a section, divided by grooves, moved by the arrow keys.

<script lang="ts">
  import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    value = $bindable(),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: AccordionPrimitive.RootProps = $props();
</script>

<!--
  Headings that each open a section, divided by grooves. No border and no
  clip: an app that wants a card puts the accordion in one, and nothing may
  clip a trigger's focus ring.
-->
<AccordionPrimitive.Root
  bind:ref
  bind:value={value as never}
  data-slot="accordion"
  class={cn("flex w-full flex-col", className)}
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts" module>
  import { getContext, setContext } from "svelte";

  /**
   * The wiring bits-ui leaves out: one id per item, made
   * here and shared, so the trigger says `aria-controls` and the content is a
   * `region` labelled by the trigger.
   */
  export type AccordionItemContext = {
    readonly triggerId: string;
    readonly contentId: string;
  };

  const KEY = "pluto:accordion-item";

  export function setAccordionItemContext(
    context: AccordionItemContext,
  ): AccordionItemContext {
    return setContext(KEY, context);
  }

  export function getAccordionItemContext(): AccordionItemContext | undefined {
    return getContext<AccordionItemContext | undefined>(KEY);
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: AccordionPrimitive.ItemProps = $props();

  const uid = $props.id();
  setAccordionItemContext({
    triggerId: `${uid}-trigger`,
    contentId: `${uid}-content`,
  });
</script>

<!-- Every item after the first carries the groove. No tint on the open item. -->
<AccordionPrimitive.Item
  bind:ref
  data-slot="accordion-item"
  class={cn("not-first:groove", className)}
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import CaretRight from "phosphor-svelte/lib/CaretRight";
  import { cn, type WithoutChild } from "$UTILS$";
  import { getAccordionItemContext } from "./accordion-item.svelte";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    level = 3,
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: WithoutChild<AccordionPrimitive.TriggerProps> & {
    /** The heading level bits-ui renders as role="heading" aria-level. Default 3. */
    level?: AccordionPrimitive.HeaderProps["level"];
  } = $props();

  const context = getAccordionItemContext();
</script>

<!--
  A heading holding a 48 px button in the heading face. One caret shows the
  state by shape: it points right when closed and down when open.
-->
<AccordionPrimitive.Header {level} class="flex">
  <AccordionPrimitive.Trigger
    data-slot="accordion-trigger"
    bind:ref
    id={context?.triggerId}
    aria-controls={context?.contentId}
    class={cn(
      "group/accordion-trigger flex h-12 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-4 py-0 text-start font-heading text-base font-bold underline-offset-4 hover:underline disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50",
      className,
    )}
    {...restProps}
  >
    {@render children?.()}
    <CaretRight
      aria-hidden="true"
      class="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground transition group-aria-expanded/accordion-trigger:rotate-90"
    />
  </AccordionPrimitive.Trigger>
</AccordionPrimitive.Header>
{@render children?.()}
